get.summary:
lncli: `bridge info`
Info reports what the bridge would charge now, per direction, without
creating or reserving anything. It is the call a payer makes to show a
price before the user commits, so it is safe to hand to participants.

post.summary:
lncli: `bridge quote`
Quote asks what a swap would cost and creates the hold invoice to pay for
it. Which direction the swap runs is worked out by asking both nodes to
decode the invoice, not by reading its prefix here.
post.description:
A quote reserves nothing until the returned hold invoice is paid, but it
does fix a rate until expires_at.

post.summary:
lncli: `bridge setrate`
SetRate changes the rate the bridge trades at, without a restart. The rate
is kept across restarts and stamped with when it was set; once it is older
than the configured limit the bridge refuses to quote until it is set
again, because a rate nobody has looked at in a moving market is a loss
waiting to be taken.

get.summary:
lncli: `bridge status`
Status reports whether this node is in a position to serve swaps: which
directions are enabled, whether both chains can be measured, whether a
usable price is available, and how many swaps are in flight.
get.description:
It answers while the bridge is refusing everything, which is the case it
exists for.

post.summary:
lncli: `bridge swap`
LookupSwap reports what the bridge believes about a swap it has quoted,
including the preimage once there is one, which is the payer's proof that
the destination was paid.

open.description: Whether a quote in this direction could succeed right now.

refusal_code.description: Why not, when it could not: a stable code and a sentence.

rate.description:
Outgoing units per incoming unit. For toSHA256, SHA256 coin per BLAKE2b
coin.

rate_set_at.description: When the rate was set, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

spread.description:
The fraction charged on top of the rate at the bridge's current position.
It can move between this call and a quote.

min_msat.description: Bounds on the invoice to be paid, in the outgoing chain's millisatoshis.

version.description: The version of the payer API this bridge speaks.

node.description:
This node's key. Every hold invoice the bridge issues on this chain is
payable to exactly this key.

hash.description: The payment hash the quote returned.

invoice.description:
The payment request the payer wants delivered, on whichever chain it is
for. It is never rewritten: its payment hash is what the hold invoice is
built on, and settling requires that exact preimage.

hold_invoice.description:
What the payer pays, on the other chain. It is a hold invoice and does not
settle until the bridge has delivered, which is the whole mechanism.

hash.description: The payment hash both legs share, and the key to ask about this swap.

incoming_msat.description:
What the payer owes. Note that incoming and outgoing are in different
units: a millisatoshi on one chain is not a millisatoshi on the other.

spread.description: The fraction charged on top of the rate.

cltv_delta.description:
The incoming leg's required CLTV, in blocks of the incoming chain. It is
sized in wall-clock by the margin policy and converted, so it is usually
far larger than a same-chain invoice would ask for.

direction.description: Which way this swap runs, for a payer deciding which node to pay from.

expires_at.description:
The deadline for paying hold_invoice, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Pay
it before this and the swap proceeds at the quoted rate; leave it and the
bridge cancels the hold invoice, after which paying it fails.

It applies only while the invoice is unpaid. Once the incoming HTLC is
locked in the swap is no longer racing a clock in minutes, and cltv_delta
is what bounds it.

rate.description: The new rate, as SHA256 coin per BLAKE2b coin.
The rate now in force and when it was set, as a Unix timestamp.

enabled.description: Whether the operator has turned the bridge on.

directions.description:
The directions this node will currently quote. A direction disappears from
here when it is disabled or when the node on that side cannot be reached.

refusals.description:
Why the bridge is refusing to quote, if it is. Empty when it is serving.
This is the field to read first: a bridge with no liquidity, an unsynced
node or a stale price refuses every swap, and the reason belongs here
rather than in a log.

swaps_in_flight.description: How many swaps are being driven right now.

rate.description: The rate in force, as SHA256 coin per BLAKE2b coin.

rate_set_at.description: When it was set, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

rate_expires_at.description:
When it stops being used, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, or zero if the
bridge allows a rate of any age.

state.description: What the bridge believes this swap is doing.

preimage.description:
Present once there is one. It is the payer's proof that the destination was
paid, and the value that claims the incoming hold invoice.
